2026-11-14 05:15:45.026586 | controller | The unit files have no installation config (WantedBy=, RequiredBy=, UpheldBy=,
2026-11-14 05:15:45.026937 | controller | Also=, or Alias= settings in the [Install] section, and DefaultInstance= for
2026-11-14 05:15:45.027025 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-11-14 05:15:45.027032 | controller |
2026-11-14 05:15:45.027038 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-11-14 05:15:45.027194 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-11-14 05:15:45.027200 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-11-14 05:15:45.027205 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-11-14 05:15:45.027240 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-11-14 05:15:45.027246 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
